items.title: Anthropic has broken with OpenAI and Google over the toughest AI safety bill in America
items.summary: A Massachusetts proposal would require large AI developers to hire independent evaluators to assess catastrophic risk in their models every four months — a cadence stricter than anything else at state level in the United States.
